paragraphs: Cantata Health Solutions sells an electronic health record called Arize. The pitch is aimed at behavioral health and human services organizations that have grown frustrated with older systems.

Arize gathers clinical, financial, operational and engagement work into a single configurable platform. Telehealth is native to the product rather than a third-party add-on. Medication handling covers computerized prescriber order entry, pharmacy and dispensing management, and an electronic medication administration record. A managed care module lets payers and their provider networks enroll clients, confirm eligibility, adjudicate claims and receive funding for services.

The company says its customers range from state hospital systems to local, regional and national providers. It puts that figure at more than 150 customers. Cantata states that it has been serving behavioral health and human services providers for over 45 years.

quote.text: Arize brings clinical, financial, operational, and engagement workflows together in one configurable platform designed around how behavioral health teams work.
